_comment: Plan B1 (docs/plans/2026-10-27-sicherheitskette/PLAN-B1-sandbox-run.md). Read only from the INSTALLED plugin directory, never from the checkout under review. An image is accepted only if `docker image inspect` reports exactly this id. Change it in a reviewed commit after a human built the image from config/sandbox/python-test.Dockerfile.

python-test._tools_comment: argv[0] must be one of these (plan Approach 4: only image-contained dependencies; anything else is refused with the B1.5 explanation).
python-test._deps_comment: Plan B1.5 (PLAN-B15-deps.md step 3). wheel_target: the tags a wheel may carry to be handed in with --deps. The image is Debian 13 with glibc 2.41 (measured 2026-11-01: platform.libc_ver() -> ('glibc', '2.41'); pip debug lists manylinux_2_41 down), CPython 3.13, amd64. All five deps_* keys or none; an image without them refuses --deps.
